before_condition: classification_origin == INFERRED_RULE_MEDIUM AND (negative_evidence OR float(confidence_margin OR 0) < 3.0)
null_handling: NULL/absent confidence_margin becomes 0.0 through (value or 0), then is treated as contradiction.
corrected_condition: Fail only when classifier negative_evidence exists, a competing-sector signal is explicitly strong, or a distinct second_sector_id exists and its actual/reconstructed scored margin is below 3. Weak mentions and missing margin alone are not contradictions.
provenance_invariant: Require core provenance; require scores/margin only when a distinct competing sector is recorded. Legacy v1.0.0 single-candidate medium rows infer NOT_APPLICABLE from the engine apply contract.
changes: app/data_quality.py: separate contradiction evidence from provenance integrity
app/sector_inference_relaxed.py: represent single-candidate margin as NOT_APPLICABLE and bump engine version
app/service.py: persist score and margin applicability provenance when an inference is applied
